description: AlphaFold pLDDT profile of CACUL1 by region
code:
import requests, json, numpy as np, os
print(sorted(os.listdir('.'))[:20])
seqs=json.load(open('seqs.json'))

r=requests.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q86Y37-F1-model_v4.pdb', timeout=120)
print('AF status', r.status_code, len(r.text))
open('AF-Q86Y37-F1-model_v4.pdb','w').write(r.text)
plddt={}
for line in r.text.split('\n'):
    if line.startswith('ATOM') and line[12:16].strip()=='CA':
        plddt[int(line[22:26])]=float(line[60:66])
import pandas as pd
s=pd.Series(plddt).sort_index()
print('n res', len(s), 'mean pLDDT', round(s.mean(),1))
regions={'N-term 1-130 (outside Pfam)':(1,130),'Pfam PF00888 137-293':(137,293),
         'IPR016159 131-334':(131,334),'C-term 294-369':(294,369)}
for k,(a,b) in regions.items():
    sub=s.loc[(s.index>=a)&(s.index<=b)]
    print(f'  {k}: mean pLDDT {sub.mean():.1f}  frac>70 {100*(sub>70).mean():.0f}%  frac<50 {100*(sub<50).mean():.0f}%')
s.to_csv('cacul1_plddt_per_residue.csv', header=['pLDDT'])

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,3.2))
ax.plot(s.index, s.values, lw=1.2, color='#2b6cb0')
ax.axhspan(0,50,color='#f56565',alpha=0.12); ax.axhspan(50,70,color='#ed8936',alpha=0.12)
ax.axhspan(70,90,color='#48bb78',alpha=0.10); ax.axhspan(90,100,color='#2f855a',alpha=0.12)
ax.axvspan(137,293,color='#4299e1',alpha=0.18)
ax.text(215,10,'Pfam PF00888 cullin repeat (137-293)',ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel('CACUL1 residue (Q86Y37)'); ax.set_ylabel('pLDDT')
ax.set_title('AlphaFold confidence across CACUL1')
ax.set_ylim(0,100); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
